visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Close-up shot of an adult's hands carefully pouring liquid from a green herbal packet into a small, transparent plastic cup. The lighting is bright and indoor. (2) The scene shifts to two toddlers sitting on an indoor wooden ledge; they both have pigtails. One wears a grey top and mustard leggings, the other a white t-shirt with a burger graphic. (3) An adult's hand enters the frame, offering the cup to the girls. The girl in the white shirt takes a large sip, and her facial expression immediately scrunches up in reaction to the taste. (4) The girl in the grey shirt then takes the cup, looking hesitant but curious, while her sister continues to make faces at the camera. (5) They continue to interact with the adult, laughing and gesturing with their hands as they refuse more of the drink. (6) The video concludes with a static pink screen featuring a cartoon girl logo and brand text.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio opens with the crisp sound of liquid being poured into a cup, accompanied by a bright, cheerful acoustic guitar and piano melody. A female voice speaks warmly, teasing the children about 'bitter tea'. (2) A series of metallic and plastic clicks follow as the cup is handled. The children's high-pitched voices join in, laughing and repeating words with a playful cadence. (3) As the toddlers drink, there are audible slurping sounds followed by exaggerated vocal reactions—gagging sounds and laughter—indicating the bitter taste. (4) The interaction continues with rapid-fire dialogue between the adult and kids, punctuated by the rhythmic acoustic BGM. (5) The clip ends with a final burst of children's laughter and a short musical resolution.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to entertain and share a humorous family moment where toddlers are challenged to taste bitter herbal tea. It captures their genuine, funny reactions for social media engagement.
